description.value: Taqueria Jalisco is a Mexican restaurant situated on the second level of a building on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, one of the city's most cyclist-friendly corridors linking the seawall and Stanley Park. The Denman Street strip is a natural refuelling stop for cyclists doing the seawall loop or passing through on tour. The taqueria format suggests a casual, quick-service Mexican menu well suited to hungry riders.
